name: mash-mix-audio-and-text-extension
description: MASH-Mix-Audio-and-Text as a Chrome extension: measure any song in the browser, find its key and its tempo, and write the lyrics with the local engine, from a file or from a link. The extension itself is plain MV3 JavaScript with no build step; this file only exists for the node test and audit tooling.
author: MASH (Khaled Bhuiyan)
